the design of the antenna for the frequency band 2-18 GHz.
the design, fabrication and testing of a new type of exponential Vivaldi antenna.
the development and optimization of the proposed structure.

this proposed exponential lensed Vivaldi antenna has a better performance than the conventional exponential Vivaldi antenna.
the proposed antenna has a better performance in comparison with the conventional exponential antipodal antenna.
the proposed design has a wide bandwidth of 1.8–18 GHz (VSWR < 2), stable radiation characteristics, and a stable gain of 7 dB in the entire frequency range.

the proposed antenna provides better performance in the wideband frequency range of 3.2-12.4 GHz.
the proposed antenna has better gain and radiation pattern than the conventional Vivaldi antenna, and the proposed antenna is more suitable for the wireless communication systems.

the use of dielectric lenses with a shape similar to the antenna aperture shape is a promising way to improve antenna performance.
